premise: Lola loves collecting shells, but the striped one is Hermit Crab's house and the ribbed one is Clam's, so she leaves every shell where it belongs.
inspiration: Andersen-style kindness tale (the child who learns that the pretty thing is someone's home), with the finding as the joy and the leaving as the gift.
lesson: Some lovely things are best left where they are.

en-US.title: Lola's Shell
en-US.text: {girl:enter} {girl:go to sand} Lola loved collecting shells. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} [excited] "Ooh, a stripy one! Cream and pink!" {hermit-crab:enter} {hermit-crab:go to sand} {girl:go to hermit-crab} She reached for it. {hermit-crab:live hide hold} But the shell… shuffled away! {girl:face surprised} [gasps] Inside, tucked up tight, was Hermit Crab. {girl:says} [gently] "Oh! Sorry. This is your house." {hermit-crab:live hide resume} Hermit Crab peeked out, {hermit-crab:face happy} and {hermit-crab:live wave} waved a tiny claw. [short pause] Then Lola found another shell, round and ribbed and peachy. {clam:enter} {girl:go to clam} She bent down {girl:live crouch} to look. {clam:live peek} It opened up… and there was Clam, with a shiny pearl inside! {clam:face surprised} {girl:says} [laughs] "You live in yours too!" {girl:face happy} So Lola didn't take a single shell home. {girl:live play-sand} She sat down and drew them all with her finger, big and happy. {hermit-crab:hearts} {clam:hearts} [warmly] And the shells stayed right where they belonged, with somebody living inside.

es-ES.title: La concha de Lola
es-ES.text: {girl:enter} {girl:go to sand} A Lola le encantaba coleccionar conchas. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} [excited] «¡Uy, una de rayas! ¡Rosa y blanca!» {hermit-crab:enter} {hermit-crab:go to sand} {girl:go to hermit-crab} Alargó la mano. {hermit-crab:live hide hold} Pero la concha… ¡se fue andando! {girl:face surprised} [gasps] Dentro, bien escondido, estaba Cangrejo Ermitaño. {girl:says} [gently] «¡Ay! Perdona. Es tu casa.» {hermit-crab:live hide resume} Ermitaño se asomó, {hermit-crab:face happy} y {hermit-crab:live wave} saludó con una pinza diminuta. [short pause] Luego Lola encontró otra concha, redonda, con rayitas y de color melocotón. {clam:enter} {girl:go to clam} Se agachó {girl:live crouch} a mirarla. {clam:live peek} Se abrió… ¡y allí estaba Almeja, con una perla brillante dentro! {clam:face surprised} {girl:says} [laughs] «¡Tú también vives en la tuya!» {girl:face happy} Así que Lola no se llevó ni una sola concha a casa. {girl:live play-sand} Se sentó y las dibujó todas con el dedo, grandes y alegres. {hermit-crab:hearts} {clam:hearts} [warmly] Y las conchas se quedaron justo donde tenían que estar, con alguien viviendo dentro.

ja-JP.title: ローラの かいがら
ja-JP.text: {girl:enter}{girl:go to sand}ローラは、かいがらあつめがだいすき。{girl:face happy}{girl:says}[excited]「わあ、しましま！クリームいろと、ピンク！」 {hermit-crab:enter}{hermit-crab:go to sand}{girl:go to hermit-crab}手をのばすと…{hermit-crab:live hide hold}かいがらが、ずりずり、にげていく！{girl:face surprised}[gasps]なかには、ちぢこまったヤドカリくん！{girl:says}[gently]「あっ、ごめんね。ここは、あなたのおうちなんだね」 {hermit-crab:live hide resume}ヤドカリくんは、ひょっこり顔を出して、{hermit-crab:face happy}小さなはさみを、{hermit-crab:live wave}ふりふり。[short pause]つぎに見つけたのは、まるくて、すじすじの、ももいろのかいがら。{clam:enter}{girl:go to clam}しゃがんで、{girl:live crouch}のぞいてみると…{clam:live peek}ぱかっ！ぴかぴかのしんじゅをもった、貝さんです！{clam:face surprised}{girl:says}[laughs]「あなたも、じぶんのおうちにすんでるんだね！」 {girl:face happy}だからローラは、かいがらを、ひとつももってかえりません。{girl:live play-sand}すわって、ゆびで、みんなの絵をかきました。大きく、にこにこに。{hermit-crab:hearts}{clam:hearts}[warmly]かいがらは、みんな、そのままに。なかに、だれかがすんでいるからね。
